name: Agatsuma Juria
source:
Chief warden of the "Sex Crime Section", the second highest hierarchy. She is also called Sister Julia.
She believes in religious correction and has the air of a clergywoman.
She rarely scolds or punishes, but at the same time, no one knows what she is thinking.

[From [url=https://qruppo.com/products/henpri/]Official Website[/url]]
